title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: 12.Stresses that the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism(CBAM) risks being an ineffective tool to ensure a levelplaying field for EU industries and prevent carbon leakage; underlines that the CBAM, as currently designed, in parallel with the phasing out of the ETS free allowances, will undermine EU competitiveness by increasing the production costs and the administrative burden for EU companies; notes the measures of the Omnibus package, but calls on the Commission for a structural revision of the CBAM and urges the postponement of phase out of ETS free allowances for EIIs; further asks for the implementation of an effective solution for EU exporters andan analysis of the possible extension to downstream products, preceded byan impact assessment;
